# Love Manga (爱漫画) fixtures

`series.html` retains the public [A.I. 医生](https://www.aimanhua.org/comic/416895) metadata and all 190 chapter links captured on 2026-10-25. Distinct IDs remain separate when chapter labels match. The word VIP in 第83话 VIP is part of the title; availability comes from the catalog structure.

The synopsis and description meta tag come from the public series response on 2026-10-27. Both end in `脑...`. The author and region rows share a CSS class; the credit row uses the `作者` label.

`reader.html` and `reader-upload3.html` retain the public reader envelopes and complete 73-page and 179-page lists. Browser save tests derive a two-page envelope from the first two issued URLs for chapter `221966`. Image responses use controlled PNG data.
